create_Dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that generates novel camera trajectories with configurable period, distance, and focal multiplier
build_Dataset_init: build a camera trajectory dataset with custom length, period, camera distance, and focal multiplier parameters
run_Dataset_getitem: run Dataset getitem to retrieve camera position, rotation matrix, focal length, and pixel coordinates for a given index
review_Dataset: review the Dataset class that computes camera poses using spherical coordinates and look-at orientation math
test_Dataset_len: test the Dataset length method to verify it returns the configured number of camera trajectory samples
